limitations: Review is static and uses existing CPU receipt; no actual B GPU terminal read or verified.
Absolute inference deadline is enforced on native/provenance children. Python metadata SHA/I/O bookkeeping and final nvidia-smi are not a separate whole-driver hard timeout.
Source saved new-forward rows are buffered file writes per batch; full data and full manifests are validated at normal completion, not a promise of crash-proof every intermediate byte.
